findings.issue: positive IEEE_SELECTED_REAL_KIND results did not assert IEEE datatype support for the returned kind
IEEE_REM and IEEE_SCALB invocations lacked per-operand datatype guards
IEEE_RINT lacked nearest-tie and inexact rows
findings.resolution: ties to even with and without ROUND; IEEE_INEXACT signals for roundToIntegralExact on a non-integral value and stays quiet with ROUND present or an integral value

findings.issue: invalid IEEE_REM NaN result was planned only for a zero divisor
findings.resolution: infinite-X invalid rows with NaN result under IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN

findings.issue: reopened: positive-control IEEE_REM/IEEE_SCALB plans were still unguarded
reopened: the zero-divisor NaN row had been lost
reopened: IEEE_REAL rows used generic 'result-kind guard' shorthand
findings.resolution: every call names its concrete IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE inquiry; a sweep found 0 unguarded restricted calls
